question: Why is the previously stated item divided into three parts here?
premises: Something previously stated is referred to.
It is conceived as having three parts.
This division serves the conception of three principles.
inference: The earlier statement is divided into three parts to establish three principles.
uncertainties: The identity of the previously stated item is not explicit in these tokens.
plain_english: Thus, what was stated before is divided into three parts in order to conceive three principles.
